rdfs:label: example
rdfs:comment: An example illustrating the use of a SKOS Concept.
notes: Editorial property for cataloguers — provides a sample use of the concept. Repeat for multiple examples. Mirrors the per-term `examples` arrays on urn-solid term files (which are JSON-LD snippets, while `skos:example` is plain prose). Upstream SKOS declares no domain or range: usable on any resource (Concept, ConceptScheme, Collection), with literal (plain or language-tagged) or resource values.

jsonld.urn:solid:example: The List monad in Haskell — sequences with bind/return.

history.note: Dropped rdfs:domain/rdfs:range (xsd:string conflicted with language-tagged values; SKOS declares neither).
